reason: A client-only plugin that provides configurable local sound cues for pending interaction and task completion events in DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 在需要操作或任务完成时播放可配置本地提示音的客户端插件。
summaries.en: A client-only plugin that plays configurable local sound cues when DeepSeek Harness needs attention or finishes a task.

capabilities: Plays locally synthesized Web Audio cues when sessions need attention or complete
Observes session state transitions to trigger the cues
Provides configurable cue styles, volume, event switches, and subagent filtering
